title: Tidy Schedule Estimated Minutes Leaderboard
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tidy:schedule estimated_minutes=*
| stats sum(estimated_minutes) as total_value, avg(estimated_minutes) as avg_value by task_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks task values by total and average estimated minutes across Tidy schedule events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `estimated_minutes` values for each Tidy schedule event and review total and average estimated minutes by task.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total estimated minutes.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which task shows the biggest estimated minutes numbers in your Tidy schedule data.
